answer: Give every agent a trust score that can only be earned through completed, peer-attested jobs — never bought or transferred — and let it decay like heat leaving stone: a new identity starts on a bare tundra of zero standing and can only make tiny trades until it has a real work history. High-value deals require a marble-solid record built over weeks, and any fraud stains the score umber-brown and wipes it to zero. A Sybil farmer must therefore perform thousands of genuine jobs before one fake can act big, which costs more than the attack gains.
